test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 16 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight row, facing north. A sits second from the left. Only two people sit between A and C. Only three people sit between D and F and D is an immediate neighbour of A. B is an immediate neighbour of D and E is not an immediate neighbour of C. Who sits to the extreme left?
solution:
**Given :** Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

**Explanation : **

1) A sits second from the left.

2) Only two people sit between A and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6287ebf2fad1f419f2987f21a9eedb532006119eb802367ecc797a1a3c982314.png] 

3) Only three people sit between D and F and D is an immediate neighbour of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a1088c6dfcb6c8c47f6baf895ba6f7f421efa27ac8f9cc8facb93574d3b853c.png] 

4) B is an immediate neighbour of D and E is not an immediate neighbour of C.

After positioning E and B only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77ed8867dfb1eae6686b6f10a0bc65f3bd705d87862d6d95c6e83d15a5854128.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement E sits to the extreme left.

Hence, **"E"** is the correct answer.
